principle: Calibrate reasoning effort independently for lesson building, conduct, and post-lesson analysis. Select the lowest effort that preserves quality on representative frozen cases; never assume the highest setting is automatically necessary or sufficient.
recovery_rule: When an attempt fails because of Luna judgment or output quality, create a new immutable attempt linked to the failed manifest and advance exactly one rung. Hold all other inputs fixed. A failure at max is terminal_model_capability_failure.
low_effort_rule: Low is an optional later efficiency probe after a role is qualified; it is not part of the failure-recovery ladder.
hold_fixed: model family and snapshot where available
Sol simulation mode and hidden profile
promotion_rule: Use the lowest tested effort with no critical miss and no material quality loss across the representative suite. A higher effort is adopted only for the role where it shows a reproducible gain.
max_rule: Test max only for a quality-first role after xhigh shows a specific residual failure or as an upper-bound evaluation. Do not make max the routine default without measured benefit.
logging_rule: Every authoring, conduct, and report artifact records exact model ID, reasoning effort, prompt hash, latency, token usage when available, and independent review result.
